sections.translation: ## STUDIO MONITOR Output Connector The **STUDIO MONITOR** output connector carries the monitoring signals to the main studio (Studio A in the UX24). **Solidyne StudioBox HD3 and HD5** monitoring bays connect directly to this output using an **RJ45–RJ45 STP** cable, with a **pin-to-pin** connection. When a StudioBox is not used, the console includes an **RJ45 to audio connectors** adapter cable, which allows for direct connection of active speakers and headphone amplifiers in the studio. The **STUDIO MONITOR** output must not be connected using cables other than the original one or via generic RJ45 adapter cables. This can cause failures or damage to the Studio Monitor output. The signals present on the **STUDIO MONITOR** connector are: | **PIN** | **SIGNAL** | | :-: | --- | | 1 | Headphones Left (\+4 dBu) | | 2 | Headphones Right | | 3 | GND | | 4 | ON-AIR (\+14 V) | | 5 | Talkback to Control Room | | 6 | VCC \+14 V | | 7 | Speakers Left (\+4 dBu) | | 8 | Speakers Right | | | \*Chassis = GND | --- **STUDIO B in UX24** To configure a monitoring circuit in a second studio, one of the general outputs is assigned, configured to be **muted** when Studio B is active.
